resource: Effect work units of one DUR-03 NPC sell-all or admitted Hireling SELL transaction
allocation_impact: The existing usage formula is 3 work units per whole BURN, 2 per partial BURN and 2 per MINT. Twenty whole BURNs plus three coin MINTs measure 66; a single Hireling item BURN plus eight coin MINTs is at most 19. The same closed native gate runs before any write.
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/npc_trade.rs (in-transaction NPC sell-all: plan and usage checked before any write; migration 0211 re-proves the lines at commit)
notes: NPC-TRADE-SELLALL-1 keeps its existing command 97 SELL_ALL shape: at most 20 whole item BURNs and 3 coin MINTs. E12 explicitly maps the same existing owner’s closed Hireling SELL shape to this resource group: the current named House, active Hireling and source offer are proved before mutation; one item BURN and at most eight physical coin MINTs pay at most 5,400,000 gold. The single-item Hireling shape uses at most nine touched items, nine custody lines, nine participants and nineteen work units, within the unchanged 23/23/23/66 ceilings. Ordinary Channel BUY/SELL retain their original shape-specific limits. See ../protocol-oteryn/v1/hireling-trade-and-audit-v1.md for the explicit mapping and source evidence.
